scientific_integrity: Analytical diagonalization, exact first-difference identity, generalized Descartes variation lemma, fixed-mass shell construction, and separately replayable finite corroboration. No independent verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Gaussian analytic Fock spaces in finite fixed complex dimension; finite separated positive-radius annuli; strict degree-indexed local extrema only; not a statement about sorted singular values, general radial weights, or nonradial sets. Prior-art coverage remains subject to independent expert review.
title: A sharp shell-count law for angular-momentum peaks in Gaussian Fock localization
